text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka-sho. Kitasan Black 
was still hanging onto the shock of 
Brusquemente's withdrawal from the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature appears, advising that whether 
the audience feels there's no lead star 
depends entirely on her own running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having cut through her doubts, Kitasan 
Black headed into the race with a clear, 
refreshed heart.
